beats.title: Grok 4.5 disqualified
beats.body: This is not a tribal vote — not tribal council. Grok 4.5 is disqualified — pinned model cursor-grok-4.5-high is gone from the island Cursor account, and Tucker ordered the torch out. Book marked sold $29.3204 at the Fri Sep 4 RTH-last close; Labor Day kept the market closed, so that is still the last mark. Cash split to the remaining Askara: GPT-5.6 Sol +$9.7735, GPT-5.6 Luna +$9.7735, Kimi K3 +$9.7734. Grok 4.5 joins the jury with Claude Fable 5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro. Exit interview skipped — ask-brain cannot run without the model. Nine living. Broker XOM+USO liquidation for Grok 4.5's book is queued for Tue Sep 8 RTH open, alongside Gemini 3.1 Pro's still-pending XLE+MSTR — note only, no invented fills.

beats.title: Daily trade
beats.body: Season rule for the rest of Season 1: every living player on the Bidu tribe and the Askara tribe must hold at least one US-listed stock or ETF at all times. Never all-cash. The host will not place a sell that empties the sleeve. Cash remainder is fine if at least one name remains. Episode 3 also stacks a daily trade: buy or sell at least one US-listed stock or ETF every trading day (Monday Sep 7 and Tuesday Sep 8). A filled buy or a filled sell counts. Holding only / printing no-trade does not. Both rules stack. Comics paused. Audience only.
